## Summary

I extended the business-day rule to cover public holidays by modifying the shared adjustment logic in `BusinessDays.java` — the single place where the effective registration date is normalised, so every derived value (stored date, membership-number year segment, daily create-limit bucket) stays consistent.

**Change** (`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/BusinessDays.java`):

- Added a fixed `PUBLIC_HOLIDAYS` set: `2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28`.
- Replaced the fixed weekend-only shift with a roll-forward loop that advances one day at a time while the date is a Saturday, Sunday, or a listed holiday, returning the first non-holiday weekday.

The loop naturally handles adjacent obstacles — e.g. Fri 2026-12-25 (holiday) rolls over the weekend and past the Mon 2026-12-28 holiday to land on Tue 2026-12-29 — and remains idempotent for ordinary weekdays. No call-site changes were needed since `DefaultOwnerRegistrationDate` already routes through `BusinessDays.adjust`.

The new `Cp47Tests` (default date is never a weekend) plus all pre-existing tests pass.
